notes.subject: fix(condense): keep in-place message updates when installing a prepared summary
notes.summary: Fixes background conversation summarization so that later in-place message updates, such as final-status markers and runtime error details, are no longer lost from the stored transcript.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): interject queued messages at the next break
notes.summary: Ask Agent in Desktop and the browser can now interject queued messages at the next tool break, and confirmed queued messages no longer vanish from the queue panel; retried and answered-question turns now send queued messages when they end.

notes.subject: feat(desktop): badge the Assistant tab with its unread inbox count
notes.summary: The Desktop app preloads the Assistant once signed in and badges the Assistant tab with its unread inbox count, retrying a failed background load when the tab is opened.
